headline: The last dance — the only THREE men ever to play six World Cups (Messi, Ronaldo, Ochoa)
summary: At WC 2026, three players reached a sixth World Cup — Lionel Messi (Argentina, defending champions), Cristiano Ronaldo (Portugal), and Mexico's goalkeeper Guillermo Ochoa. They are the ONLY three in history to do so; the previous ceiling was five (Lothar Matthäus, Gianluigi Buffon, Rafael Márquez). UPDATE 2026-07-06: Ronaldo's dance is OVER — Portugal lost 1-0 to Spain in the R16 (Mikel Merino 90+1' sub winner), confirmed pre-match this was his last World Cup, exits with 3 goals this tournament but no trophy. Messi is still alive in the bracket (Argentina beat Egypt 3-2 in the R16, 2026-07-07, coming from 2-0 down in the final 11 minutes) — the last-dance torch is now his alone among the three.
